text.content: What type of tasks can the AutoGen agents do?
AutoGen agents can converse to solve tasks.
In what way the AutoGen interacts with humans and form a chat?
They can form a chat, potentially with humans in the loop.
What does the AutoGen framework support?
The framework supports flexible conversation patterns.
What kind of tasks can AutoGen agents accomplish?
AutoGen agents can converse with each other to accomplish tasks.
What abilities does AutoGen offer to developers?
Using AutoGen, developers can also flexibly define agent interaction behaviors.
What does AutoGen enable for diverse LLM-based applications?
AutoGen enables diverse LLM-based applications using multi-agent conversations.
What are AutoGen agents based on?
AutoGen agents are based on LLMs, tools, humans, or even a combination of them.
